#### PR description:

This PR updates the global tag for the 2023 and 2024 PbPb rereco workflows to the one derived by AlCA in https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/offline-rereco-hi-data-reprocessing-of-run-3/148969/23

#### PR validation:

Tested with workflows 141.501,142.501

To be backported to 17_0_X
